concept.title: Several short lists, not one long tree
concept.shortdesc: Each service is described on several independent dimensions, each with its own short list of values, instead of being filed in one place in a single tree.

conbody.p: Most directories file each service in one place in a single tree of categories, like a book on a library shelf. That forces awkward choices. Is a health walk for older people filed under sport, health, or older people?
A single tree also grows without limit, because every activity can be combined with every audience: yoga, pregnancy yoga, yoga for carers, chair yoga for over-70s.
The design instead describes each service on several independent dimensions, each with its own short list of values.

fig.title: One listing described on several independent dimensions

image.alt: An illustrative directory listing for a weekly strength and balance class, broken into six separate descriptions: what it is, what it helps with, who it is for, who runs it, how it is delivered and how you get in.

conbody.p: Readers who know clinical coding will recognise the principle from SNOMED CT.
